Human Resources Department Overview
Meridian Dynamics Inc. — Internal Document
Overview
The Human Resources department at Meridian Dynamics Inc. is headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu,
India (Global Headquarters) and is identified internally by the department code HR. The department is led
by Divya Ramaswamy, who holds the title of Director of Human Resources and reports to Priya Chandran. Human Resources operates as one of the 13 core departments of Meridian Dynamics Inc., alongside
Information Technology, Information Security, Finance, Procurement and other functions, and coordinates
closely with these departments on cross-functional initiatives. Team Structure
The Human Resources department currently comprises 6 employees on record, including:
- Priya Chandran (Chief Human Resources Officer, Human Resources department, based in Chennai)
reports to Ananya Raghunathan. - Neha Kapoor (Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources department, based in Chennai)
reports to Divya Ramaswamy. - Sanjay Verma (Senior Manager, Compensation & Benefits, Human Resources department, based in
Chennai) reports to Divya Ramaswamy. - Kavya Reddy (HR Business Partner, Human Resources department, based in Bangalore) reports to
Divya Ramaswamy. - Arvind Balasubramanian (Learning & Development Manager, Human Resources department, based in
Chennai) reports to Divya Ramaswamy. Systems Maintained
Workday HRMS is maintained by the Human Resources department and is used for core human
resources management, leave, payroll and benefits administration. GreytHR Self-Service Portal is maintained by the Human Resources department and is used for employee
self-service for leave requests and payslips. Policies Owned
Leave and Attendance Policy (POL-HR-001) is owned by Human Resources and applies to all
Employee Benefits Policy (POL-HR-002) is owned by Human Resources and applies to all departments.
question: Where is the Global Headquarters of the Human Resources department located?
